title: Konosaki — Bilingual Consulting Brand & Website
jpTitle: Konosaki — 越境コンサルティングのブランド構築

summary.en: Designed and built the complete AI-assisted brand system and bilingual website for Konosaki LLC, a cross-border Japan/global consulting firm, around one idea — a bridge connecting 'kono' (this) and 'saki' (ahead). Covers logo, color and type system, guidelines, business cards, presentation templates, social templates and a live Next.js/React site.
summary.jp: Konosaki のために、ブランドと 2 言語サイトを 1 人で作った。「この（kono）」と「先（saki）」を橋渡しする発想が軸。ロゴから名刺、Next.js 製サイトまで AI を使って構築した。

product.en: A solo, AI-assisted build end to end — brand strategy through a live Next.js website — used as evidence that one person plus AI tooling can now ship what used to require a small studio.
product.jp: 戦略から Next.js 製サイトまで、1 人と AI だけで作り切った。小さな制作会社が担っていた工程を、1 人と AI の組み合わせで通せる証。

mine: Designed and built the complete brand system solo — strategy, logo, guidelines, website and collateral — AI-assisted
Placed a bridge symbol between 'kono' (this) and 'saki' (ahead) in the primary lockup
Built the bilingual website with parallax storytelling and page transitions (Next.js/React, Vercel)
Designed the color system (Konosaki Blue plus extended palette) and typography (Geist + Noto Sans JP)
Designed business cards, letterhead/email signature, a 12-master presentation deck and LinkedIn carousel templates

label.en: core idea — a bridge — carried across languages, cultures and markets
label.jp: 核となる発想 1 つで全体を統一

narrative.situation: Konosaki is a bilingual consulting partner connecting Japanese and global businesses.

_notes: The presentation-deck template mockups shown on the page contain placeholder client metrics (e.g. '40% faster decision cycles,' '98% client retention') and a placeholder name 'Name Surname' — these are template sample content for Konosaki's own future decks, not Takao's project outcomes, and are excluded per instruction.
No explicit project year on the page; a template mockup footer shows '2023' but that is not treated as a confirmed project date.

cardKind.jp: ブランド拡張 · 公開中

cardLine.en: One idea — this, and ahead — carried from the logo to a live bilingual site.
cardLine.jp: 「この」と「先」。ロゴから公開中の二言語サイトまで、ひとつの考えで通した。
